result.title: Complexity-Aware Surgical Video Reasoning Segmentation with Digital Twin and Context Memory
result.summary: Conventional surgical segmentation relies on closed-set categories or explicit text queries, which cannot resolve implicit queries that require reasoning about workflows, instrument functions, and temporal relationships. To address these limitations, we propose SurgReasonSeg, a complexity-aware method that brings reasoning segmentation over digital twin (DT) representations to surgical video. Specifically, SurgReasonSeg constructs DT representations from surgical foundation models and trains two low-rank adapters (LoRA) of one large language model with reinforcement learning (RL), each specialized for a different query complexity. A lightweight router, also trained with RL, selects between the two adapters to balance latency against accuracy. SurgReasonSeg also sets the temporal context with an adaptive sliding window conditioned on query complexity and workflow phase, and retrieves relevant historical cases from a surgical context memory by workflow similarity and procedural relevance. We further introduce EndoVis-ReasonSeg, a surgical reasoning segmentation benchmark with 1,460 training and 961 test samples across semantic, spatial, and temporal categories. On EndoVis-ReasonSeg, SurgReasonSeg improves J&F over the strongest baseline, ReSurgSAM2, by 0.178, 0.237, and 0.297 on semantic, spatial, and temporal queries, and it also achieves the best results on the Ref-EndoVis17 and Ref-EndoVis18 referring segmentation benchmarks. A backbone-matched attribution protocol separates the contribution of the upstream segmenter from that of the reasoning modules. Our method runs at 18.8 FPS averaged over the query distribution, enabling real-time reasoning segmentation in surgical videos.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 SurgReasonSeg，在手术视频上用手术基础模型构建数字孪生表示，以强化学习训练两个按查询复杂度区分的 LoRA 适配器和一个路由器，并结合自适应时序窗口与按流程相似度检索的历史案例记忆，同时发布 EndoVis-ReasonSeg 推理分割基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 复杂度感知路由、自适应窗口与上下文记忆涉及「何时扩展视觉证据、如何分配计算」的问题，可供核查 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的成本收益与证据筛选；但核心仍是分割与数字孪生表示，未涉及推理期 latent 状态，联系较间接。
